restaurantName: Gucci Osteria da Massimo Bottura Tokyo
bio: A collaboration between two great Italian exports: fashion and fine dining. Gucci Osteria, a worldwide series of Italian contemporary restaurants, began with a handshake between a Florentine fashion creator and a celebrated chef from Modena. The result is a fusion between the magical world of Gucci, with its trademark green, and the avant-garde sensibilities of Massimo Bottura, a playful yet elegant cuisine that is always on the cutting edge of the times....
